description: Keeps a file explorer pinned to any project or thread while you switch between BB threads. Pin a folder from a searchable list of project sources, thread workspaces, and personal roots. Search by file name or path and jump the tree to matches, including bare file names resolved across configured search roots. Search and replace text inside files with case, whole-word, regex, and include or exclude glob options, or scope a search to one folder from its context menu. Right-click files and folders to preview, create, rename, delete, copy relative or absolute paths, add paths to chat drafts, or reveal them in the system file manager.
